query: SELECT item.name, item.description, item_type.name AS item_type, location.name AS "location?", holder.name AS "held_by?" FROM item JOIN item_type ON item_type.id = item.item_type_id LEFT JOIN item_location ON item_location.item_id = item.id LEFT JOIN location ON location.id = item_location.location_id LEFT JOIN item_character ON item_character.item_id = item.id LEFT JOIN character AS holder ON holder.id = item_character.character_id WHERE item.id = ?
